run.change_description: [field] Sync controlled value changes with field state

summary.intent: Make Field.Control sync controlled value changes with field state through useValueChanged, fix dirty tracking for non-string values, and honor details.cancel().
summary.issue_fit: Partial: no issue exists, so alignment was unavailable and intent comes from the commit message and the supplied PR text. The dirty, programmatic-sync, cancel and reject/rewrite outcomes are met; one regression in the removed mount-time filled reset remains.
summary.coverage: Both changed files reviewed against the full merge-base diff; the changed tests read and the FieldControl suite run at the head; probe tests exercised cancel, reset, async-validator and render-count behavior; uncommitted changes not reviewed.
check_details: Reviewer ran the FieldControl jsdom suite (`vitest run --project @base-ui/react packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.test.tsx`) at 14d39e5d1ad6b7aca2fb067415dba09c6bea219b: 26 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0.

Reviewer ran scratch jsdom probes from the work directory at the head and against a `git archive` copy of the merge-base: the remount probe printed data-filled true at the head and false at the merge-base.
No CI evidence was supplied; the chromium mode and rendered-output checks were unavailable (no browser).

findings.title: Reset filled state when a controlled Field.Control mounts empty
findings.trigger: A Field.Root stays mounted while its controlled Field.Control unmounts and remounts: the user types 'abc', the control is hidden, the parent state becomes '' while it is hidden, and the control is shown again with value=''. The merge-base mount effect called setFilled(false) for a controlled '', this change deleted that branch, and useValueChanged cannot fire on mount.
findings.impact: The Field.Root keeps data-filled although the mounted input is empty, so filled-dependent styling such as floating labels renders a filled state for an empty input; a probe printed filled=true at the head and filled=false at the merge-base.
findings.change: In the mount layout effect in `FieldControl.tsx`, also clear filled when the control is controlled and its DOM value is empty, for example by calling `setFilled(Boolean(validation.inputRef.current?.value))` when `isControlled`, and add a remount test.
findings.source: commit-14d39e5/"Sync controlled value changes with field state"

observations.fact: In uncontrolled mode a canceled change skips error clearing and validation but still updates dirty and filled, which follow the DOM value.
observations.evidence: `packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx:148-156`; scratch probe printed filled=true dirty=true invalid=false after details.cancel().

observations.fact: A programmatic reset of a controlled required field to '' in onChange mode clears data-dirty and data-filled but shows the valueMissing error, because markedDirtyRef stays true.
observations.evidence: `packages/react/src/field/root/useFieldValidation.ts:225`; scratch probe printed filled=false dirty=false invalid=true with the Required error visible.

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/"Dirty state never cleared for non-string values"
requirements.evidence: FieldControl.tsx:86-97 registers String(value); test 'clears dirty state when a numeric controlled value returns to its initial value' passes. Public validityData.initialValue is typed unknown; the numeric case now holds a string, and no in-repo consumer relies on the old type (downstream readers not enumerable, no concrete conflict).

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/"Programmatic changes left the field stale"
requirements.evidence: FieldControl.tsx:105-115 syncs clearErrors, dirty, filled and validation on value change; test 'syncs state and validates when the controlled value changes programmatically' passes; probe showed a stale async validator result discarded after a programmatic change.

FieldControl.tsx:144-146 returns early and useValueChanged owns the controlled path, but the mount-time filled reset for a controlled empty value was dropped (finding field/control/remount-filled-stale).

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/"details.cancel() in onValueChange now stops the internal handling"
requirements.evidence: FieldControl.tsx:153 gates clearErrors and validation on details.isCanceled; test 'does not validate when the change is canceled' passes. Dirty and filled still track the DOM value (see observation).

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/"A controlled value the consumer rejects or rewrites no longer reaches the field state"
requirements.evidence: FieldControl.tsx:144-146 skips field-state updates in controlled mode; state syncs only from the serialized value prop; no dedicated test, verified by trace.

The committed steady-state test passes at 1 render per keystroke in onSubmit mode; a probe counted 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 renders across mount and four keystrokes in onChange mode, matching the reported 2 per keystroke. The Number Field column was not measured.
